first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Wearing a wide, bulky white extravehicular suit and a white round helmet with a transparent visor, with a gray-white assembly in front of the body; in the later segment, red bands on the suit are visible.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: A distant partial view of a planet in the lower left of the image, with a blue-white surface, white cloud patterns, and a light-blue bright curved rim.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: The nearly uniform deep-black distant background visible beyond Person A, the planetary background, and the exterior spacecraft structure.

entities.name: gray exterior bulkhead and frame
entities.identification: An exterior spacecraft environmental structure composed of dark beams, a large gray-blue panel surface, and a relatively thick structure along the side.

At frame 0, Person A is positioned horizontally in the near foreground. The wide, bulky white extravehicular suit is illuminated by strong light, forming large bright-white areas, while fabric folds remain visible in the darker areas; the white round helmet has a transparent visor, the edge of which shows blue-green reflections, and the facial area inside is extremely bright. Dark connectors, cables, and casing can be discerned on the gray-white assembly in front of the chest, and the outline of a round shoulder patch is visible on the upper arm.
